scripts.prod:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up --build -d prod && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml logs -tf prod
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml stop prod && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml rm -f prod
scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml logs -tf dev
scripts.dev:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up --build -d dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml logs -tf dev
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml stop dev && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml rm -f dev
